3081193: Part 6 (22 marks)
Recall the Textoggle game from Assignment 1. Textoggle was played on an n x n board. Each square on the board could either have an uppercase English letter, or a 'blank' character. Like in Scrabble, blanks could be used to represent any character. The Textoggle board was represented as a list of lists of characters. The 'blank' character is represented as an underscore ('_'). For example, one Textoggle board could look like this:
board = [['X', 'A', 'E', 'H'],['I', 'S', 'R', 'T'],['C', 'K', 'E', '_'],['M', 'U', 'O', 'S']]
In this part, you will write a number of functions to process Textoggle boards. You may write other supporting functions if you wish, but are not required to. For each of these questions, you may assume the board is at least 2 x 2, and does not contain any blank tiles.
Note that you will not be able to use the Tab key in the questions below. You should indicate indentation by using four space characters in place of a Tab. You are also encouraged to use the Preformatted font for consistent character spacing.
